text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... thanks, Big Brother.
Ehehe... thanks, Big Sister.

I could hear everyone's voices while<n>I was
running.

You can do it! "Go, Rice, go!"<n>Everyone was urging
me onward.

Hehe, this isn't right. I promised I<n>would make
everyone smile...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But I'm the one who can't stopsmiling!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I'm so glad that I got to run inthe Takarazuka Kinen!
choice_data_list: Everyone else feels the same way.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...They do?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Riiiice! Thank yooou!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: This was the best Takarazuka Kinen<n>ever!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Wow! There are happy faces<n>everywhere!
choice_data_list: They're all smiling because of you.
They're all smiling because of you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because of... me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... there's no way. The blue rose<n>brings
happiness, not misfortune, the<n>way I do.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It would take someone really special<n>to make
everyone smile like—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! That means... I... did it...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I brought happiness to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Nnng... Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She bursts into tears, shoulders<n>quivering, while the
audience warmly<n>applauds her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: At night...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Inhale... exhale...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Heh, yeah. I can't just keep crying<n>forever.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I have to smile at everyone while I'm<n>up onstage,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That way I can show them how<n>thankful I am to
have their support.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And that tonight, I'll bring them all<n>happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Is that too much?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! If you say so, then<n>I'm sure it's
fine.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! If you say so, then<n>I'm sure it's
fine.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'm off! I have to go see<n>everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, Rice Shower puts on her best<n>winning
concert performance yet.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next day, a large picture of her<n>graces the front
page of the<n>newspaper.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And thus blooms on Yodo turf a<n>beautiful blue
rose—a new star, Rice<n>Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Brother! I want to run in the<n>Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sister! I want to run in the<n>Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yes! You see, I heard...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon and McQueen are racing<n>there!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So I want to join too! It'll be the<n>ultimate race!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Like the Takarazuka Kinen, the Arima<n>Kinen is a
race in which only the most<n>popular runners can
participate.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
To think, she's now able to say she<n>wants to
participate without worrying<n>about the requirements.
Which<n>means...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did I get taller?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Then, what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-tell me, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-tell me, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower spends the rest of the<n>day following
me around, pestering<n>me for an answer.
